name: Character Studio
summary: Keeps facial likeness and clothing style 100% identical while changing pose, action, and background.

inputs.help: Single portrait photo, or collage sheet showing multiple angles of the face

inputs.label: Outfit & Clothing Reference
inputs.help: Photo of the dress, outfit, or garment style to preserve identically

inputs.label: Background & Environment
inputs.help: Optional location, scenery, or environment reference photo

inputs.label: Action & Description
inputs.default: sitting comfortably at an outdoor café table, smiling towards the camera, holding a warm cup
inputs.help: Describe what the character is doing and the atmosphere. Facial identity and outfit style remain identical.

bind.template: A high-end photorealistic studio photograph. The person has the identical face, facial features, bone structure, eye shape, nose, lips and hairstyle of the person in Picture 1. The person is wearing the exact same outfit, fabrics, cut and clothing style as in Picture 2. Environment and location: Picture 3. Framing: {shot}. Pose: {pose}. Action: {action}. Ultra-detailed, authentic skin pores, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, perfectly consistent likeness.
